The change is sound overall and the new classification is applied consistently.
One issue is worth raising before this ships.

Full review comments:

- [P2] Cleanup runs before the row is marked failed - backend/app/services/example_upload.py:266-274
  The cleanup deletes the staged object and only then writes the failed status.
  If the process dies between the two, the next reader sees a pending row whose
  object no longer exists, and the recovery path cannot tell that case from a
  slow upload still in flight. Write the status first, or make the reader treat a
  missing object on a pending row as a failure rather than as work in progress.

This is the only defect I would hold the change for.
